reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: liquidation_inner has 3 non-test callers in market.move (L530, L597, L663). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined; the attack vector is a permissionless external liquidator, not a trusted data source. Gate 3: market.move is explicitly in-scope; liquidation logic is a named focus area. The proof trace confirms EMA prices are used for the pre-liquidation health check (ensure_liquidate_borrow_allowed) while SPOT prices drive the seizure calculation (liquidate_calculate_seize_ctokens), with no post-liquidation health assertion — meaning when SPOT drops significantly below EMA, seized collateral can exceed economic justification and worsen the borrower's risk ratio rather than improve it. Attack path requires a liquidator to act during a SPOT/EMA divergence event (30-50% gap), which is market-condition-dependent, hence CONFIRMED_POTENTIAL rather than CONFIRMED_VULNERABILITY.
